authoring.author: claude-opus-5.5 (house-types pilot lane)
authoring.note: De Clercqstraat 22-2 (north side, Nassaukade end), 1898-1901. Shop street: uniform uppers, a different shop on every ground floor. 3 types: E (dark brick, corbel cornice; 7 modules in 4 pands, crowns none/tower/step), F (stucco cornice + mansard; 3 pands), and the Nassaukade corner 116526 as its own type. 153066 (crenellated corner block) keeps its own design. Multi-module pands (16-18 = 3 modules, 8-10 = 2) are one front per module with its own shop. Shops read on the 2021-03-24 strip (zoom crops) and checked against OSM/BAG; illegible lettering is left out, never invented. Pass 2 after the strip sheet: tower rises from the photo (height gate), wall colours toward the measured wall medians (model read too saturated/dark).
